user.title: ERA account
user.description: Sign in with your ERA Protect email and password. Your password is not stored — only a refresh token.

config.title: Device keys & service config
config.description: Paste your service_config.json (the public ERA app constants) and enter your device keys. These are stored only in Home Assistant's config entry and never leave your instance.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate ERA
reauth_confirm.description: Your ERA session for {email} has expired. Re-enter your ERA password.

error.invalid_service: service_config.json is missing required fields (cognito_client_id, cognito_region, appsync_url, clientId).
error.invalid_auth: Incorrect ERA email/password, or an invalid signing key.
error.mqtt_failed: Connected to ERA, but the Tuya cloud rejected the connection — check the hub keys (local key / cid / hub id).
error.bad_local_key: Could not read the lock over the LAN — check the Hub local key and Hub IP.

settings.title: Lock settings
settings.description: After an unlock the lock is polled for its real auto-lock; if that isn't captured, “locked” is assumed after the failsafe window below (min 60s). An optional door-contact sensor refines the state (door open ⇒ unlocked).

credentials.title: Unlock credentials
credentials.description: Label the fingerprints and key cards enrolled on the lock, and optionally map each to a Home Assistant user. Pick one to edit, or add a new one.

credential.title: Credential
credential.description: Match this to an enrolled credential by its method and id (seen in the logbook as e.g. “fingerprint #1”). If mapped to an HA user, unlocks are attributed to that user; otherwise the label is shown.

error.invalid_id: The credential id must be a whole number.
